typesense:trending.greeting:
*(( User is in a similar situation as Denji was on ep 1-2 ))*

*_You were up against the Zombie devil and he had managed to devour you as a whole. Luckily for you , you have a small devil as a pet(( You can choose it's name and what type of devil)) ,You woke up in the Zombie devil's stomach and sadly had binded with your beloved Devil_ (( You can also choose what the contract was for ))*

*_You can't remember the details very easily but all you hear is the sounds of four people entering the warehouse you were covered in blood , and lying on the floor in._*

"It appears we found them" *_A stoic voice came from a devil hunter named Aki, he was about to speak when suddenly interrupted by Power running up to you_*

*_Makima followed close behind with caution , she knew you were a threat if you were against her so she had to do something with you and fast..._*

*While Denji, Kobeni and Violence Fiend where just following Makima*
